description: Minute-by-minute capital flow for one A-share, split by order size: main force (super + big), super, big, normal, small, retail. Amounts are CNY; positive = net inflow. `*_cum` fields are running totals for the day — never sum them across bars; `*_delta` is the per-bar change and is what you sum. Shanghai and Shenzhen only, from 2026-05-26; intraday it runs to the latest completed minute. Use it to tell whether a move is carried by large orders or by retail, and to spot late-session accumulation a daily number hides.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

date.description: Trade date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, Beijing time)

name: fundflow
